user.title: BeamIn
user.description:
Sign in to Home Assistant on any device (car, wall tablet, TV, a friend's computer) by approving it from a phone that is already signed in. No password to type.

After setup, open **{beam_url}** on the new device and bookmark it.

data_description.request_ttl: How long a code stays valid on the device screen.
data_description.temporary_minutes: A temporary session is revoked automatically after this time, even across restarts.
data_description.public_url: Address your phone uses to reach Home Assistant, such as {example_url}. Leave empty to use the external URL of Home Assistant.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: When hidden, the approval screen stays reachable by scanning the QR code or at /beamin.

error.invalid_url: Enter an address such as {example_url}, without a path.
